title: Creepigs
description: Brings back the original pig model
body:
This resource pack changes the pig model to look like a creeper, a reference to the fact that the creeper was based on a scuffed pig model. This pack requires Optifine.

![A creepig](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61ebc9ac39fe837845b94be99a2d217cf0f50832_0.webp)
![old pig model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef0c69fad368c6737ce6b2f15f66f6ccf1e20b49.jpeg)

I didn't just reuse the creeper model, I recreated it using Blockbench.
